main_measure.name: t of the mean of |forecast|-weighted unusual 10-bar falls on short grid cases
main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= 2 over at least 30 cases (and supporting check passes); reject if t <= -2 over at least 30 cases

supporting_check.name: mean unusual fall, top third |forecast| minus bottom third

decided_by: The main t is 2 or more over at least 30 cases and the top third shows a larger unusual fall than the bottom third.
reading: Situation taken as raw support_above > 0 on bars whose regime is mean_reversion (the recorded decision of the 90-bar return >= -50 % rule) with a negative forecast; the coin's mean 10-bar return is taken over the non-overlapping grid of all its windows; thirds are floor(n/3) cases each by |forecast| (unweighted unusual fall); fewer than 30 cases is reported as not observable.
